M2 gcd style while tuple assign
M3 tuple assign in loop then mod
code:
def g2(a, b):
    while b:
        t = a % b
        a = b
        b = t
    return a
print(g2(48, 36), g2(4, 6))

name: M6 class add returns new instance
M7 method call after class attr bump
code:
class C:
    n = 0
    def bump(self):
        C.n += 1
        return C.n
obj = C()
print(obj.bump())
